---
title: Community
---

Beyond the manual and [Support](support.qmd), there are a few ways to connect
with other operators and the WP2 team, and to contribute back to the project.

## NBIS Slack

WP2 — the team that operates the servers hosting the BigPicture datasets you
submit to — offers help on the [`nbisweden.slack.com`](https://nbisweden.slack.com) Slack workspace, in
addition to the [Support](support.qmd) channels.

::: {.callout-important}
## Precondition: access must be requested

The workspace is not open sign-up. Request an invite via
[bp-ops](mailto:{{< var email.bpops >}}) — the same contact used in
[Support](support.qmd).
:::

## Reporting issues

Filing an issue is itself a form of community participation — it surfaces a
problem for other operators before they hit it, and it's how the pipeline and
this manual improve. The trackers to use, and what belongs on each, are listed
under [Reporting issues](support.qmd#reporting-issues) in Support.

## mappers.xlsx sharing

Every site currently authors its own [`mappers.xlsx`](bp-submission-pipeline/reference-data-mappers.qmd)
from scratch, even though many sites map the same local short codes (common
stains, specimen types, preparation methods) to the same BigPicture coded
attributes.

::: {.callout-note}
## Not yet available

Cross-site sharing of `mappers.xlsx` mappings doesn't exist yet. It's tracked
upstream as bp-submission-pipeline milestone
[**mappers.xlsx community sharing**](https://github.com/imi-bigpicture/bp-submission-pipeline/milestone/10)
— this section documents the intent, not a working feature. Once it ships,
this page will link to the how-to.
:::
